name: Hotel Alpin
beschreibung: The Hotel Alpin welcomes guests to the heart of the idyllic village of Scheffau am Wilden Kaiser at Dorf 29, nestled at the foot of the mighty Kaisergebirge limestone cliffs. Decorated in a warm Tyrolean cottage style, the comfortable rooms feature modern en-suite bathrooms with shower/WC, satellite TV, Wi-Fi, and sunny balconies with sweeping views of the Wilder Kaiser. After an active day outdoors, the on-site wellness area with Finnish sauna, steam bath, and relaxation lounge offers soothing rejuvenation. Each morning, a nutritious breakfast buffet loaded with local regional specialities prepares visitors for alpine adventures, complemented by authentic Tyrolean dinners in the evening. The lower station of the Brandstadlbahn gondola, doorway into the vast SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser–Brixental, is just minutes away via the complimentary ski bus. In summer, emerald Lake Hintersteiner See and the KaiserWelt park delight all.
kurzbeschreibung: Cosy alpine hotel at Dorf 29 in Scheffau at the Wilder Kaiser featuring traditional rooms, wellness area, and near the Brandstadlbahn.
